svg.title: GEMM iteration box with one tile and its operand panels
svg.desc: Isometric box of M by N by K multiply-adds; one tile is highlighted with its A panel, B panel and C tile projected onto the three walls.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: GEMM as a box of multiply-adds: tiling picks a sub-box that fits in fast memory

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C[M×N] += A[M×K] · B[K×N] — every point (m, n, k) is one FMA; a tile reuses its A and B panels many times

path.title: A panel (Mt×Kt) — reused for every n in the tile
B panel (Kt×Nt) — reused for every m in the tile
C tile (Mt×Nt) — accumulates over k, stays in registers
